description: Two eight step pitch and gate sequences running together, with a per step chance deciding which of them is heard

params.text: Advances the sequence one step, as a rising edge at the clock jack does
Sends the sequence back to its first step
Sets the number of steps the sequence runs before it returns to the first, 1 to 8
Sets the voltage the A/B select jack is compared against, 0V to 10V; below it sequence A plays and at or above it sequence B
Sets the note for that step of that sequence, 0V to 1V, added to the octave knob beside it
Sets the octave for that step of that sequence, -10 to 10, added to the note knob beside it
Sets the chance that step plays from sequence B rather than sequence A, 0 always giving A and 1 always giving B
Sets the gate length for that step of that sequence, as a share of one clock beat; 0 mutes the step and 1 holds the gate for the whole beat
Sets how far a randomise trigger moves a control, as a share of its full range
Randomises the eight note knobs of that sequence, by the amount set by the randomise knob
Randomises the eight gate knobs of that sequence, by the amount set by the randomise knob
Replaces every control covered by the Module Randomization menu with a fresh random value

inputs.text: A rising edge here advances the sequence one step
A rising edge here sends the sequence back to its first step
Chooses the sequence directly instead of by chance: below the threshold knob sequence A plays, at or above it sequence B
Sets the number of steps, read over the range set by the Step Input Scale menu; the red lamp lights when the voltage would give a step count outside 1 to 8
Plays that sequence's notes from a polyphonic cable, one channel per step, in place of its note and octave knobs
Sets that sequence's gate lengths from a polyphonic cable, one channel per step
A rising edge here randomises the eight note knobs of that sequence
A rising edge here randomises the eight gate knobs of that sequence

outputs.text: Carries the pitch of whichever sequence won the chance on this step
Carries sequence A's pitch on every step, whether or not it won
Carries sequence B's pitch on every step, whether or not it won
Sends a 1ms pulse as the sequence reaches its last step
Carries the gates of whichever sequence won the chance on this step

notes: nothing moves until a clock reaches the clock jack or the button beside it is pressed
gate length is measured against the time between the last two clocks, so the gates settle to the right length only after the second clock
the two small lamps under each chance knob show which sequence that step last played from
menu: Polyphonic Gate Out — puts each step's gate on its own channel of the three gate outputs instead of putting them all on one
Update knobs from polyphony inputs — moves the note and gate knobs to match a polyphonic cable as it plays, so the panel shows what is being played
Copy A V1 -> B — copies sequence A's eight note knobs onto sequence B's
Copy A V2 -> B — copies sequence A's eight octave knobs onto sequence B's
Copy B V1 -> A — copies sequence B's eight note knobs onto sequence A's
Copy B V2 -> A — copies sequence B's eight octave knobs onto sequence A's
Copy A Gates -> B — copies sequence A's eight gate knobs onto sequence B's
Copy B Gates -> A — copies sequence B's eight gate knobs onto sequence A's
Randomize Notes only — the four randomise buttons and jacks move the note knobs and leave the octaves alone
Randomize Notes and Octave — the four randomise buttons and jacks move the note and octave knobs together
Include V1 (Notes) — whether the big randomise button touches the note knobs
Include V2 (Octaves) — whether the big randomise button touches the octave knobs
Include Gates — whether the big randomise button touches the gate knobs
Include Probability — whether the big randomise button touches the chance knobs
Include Steps — whether the big randomise button touches the step count
0.0 to 1.0 — reads the steps jack over a one volt range
0.0 to 8.0 — reads the steps jack over an eight volt range
0.0 to 10.0 — reads the steps jack over a ten volt range, and is the setting the module comes up in

inputs.1: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.3:
unipolar · stepped · one channel only
